channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Indiana completes undefeated season and wins first national title, beating Miami 27-21 in CFP final
item.description: Fernando Mendoza lowered his pads into a defender, spun in a full circle, used his hand to keep his balance, then launched himself horizontally and reached the ball over the goal line — an Indiana touchdown and a ready-made poster pic for a title run straight from the movies.

item.title: Minnesota leaders call for investigation into death of a man at ICE facility in Texas
item.description: The man was detained by ICE in Minneapolis on Jan. 6.

item.title: Send us your photos of the northern lights in Minnesota
item.description: The aurora could be visible across much of the northern tier of U.S. states on Monday night.

item.title: The Black man and women who rescued right-wing influencer Jake Lang from protesters in Minneapolis
item.description: Isaiah Blackwell used his body as a shield in guiding Lang away from counterprotesters before two Black women were his unexpected getaway drivers.

item.title: Fewer Minnesotans have opted for MNsure health insurance. More could drop soon
item.description: State officials said higher premiums and diminished federal tax credits mean some people likely feel they can’t afford coverage.

item.title: St. Paul mayor Kaohly Her ‘livid’ after ICE wrongly targets family friend, escorts him undressed into cold
item.description: ChongLy Scott Thao was taken by federal agents from his St. Paul home in the frigid cold only wearing boxers and Crocs.

item.title: Shot nine times, Sen. John Hoffman is resolute in continuing political life
item.description: Hoffman was shot in the doorway of his home in the same spate of violence that killed House DFL Leader Melissa Hortman.

item.title: The latest: Department of Justice plans to appeal court order restricting ICE tactics in Minnesota
item.description: Court order limited federal agents from arresting, detaining, retaliating against or using force and chemical irritants against peaceful protesters and observers.
